newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: TAG Heuer raises IPO size by 35 percent.
newsitem.headline: TAG Heuer raises IPO size by 35 percent.

text.p: Swiss sports watch and chronograph TAG Heuer International SA said it would expand the size of a public offering by approximately 35 percent.
TAG Heuer said in a statement it was responding to strong interest since the offering was launched on September 5.
It said the additional shares and options for shares to cover over-allotments would come from a stake held by Doughty Hanson & Co, which had 41 percent before the offering.
"After taking into account the increase in the size of the offer, the free float will be increased to approximately 50 percent," it said without elaborating.
It said the price of the shares was now expected to be announced on September 27, when trading on the Swiss exchange the New York Stock Exchange would also commence.
